what: xM$ is what the free-agent market would pay this winter: years, AAV and the NPV guarantee, each with P10 and P90. Fair $ is what the projected production is worth at the same term. The two are separate numbers and are never subtracted. A board prospect shows Fair $ only, the NPV of his eFV WAR path; his xM$ is withheld (outside the market model's range).
